# secflow
Zero-cost security scanning for AI-driven repos — gitleaks + trivy + npm audit + regex, AI-ready fix reports

## Core
- [README.md](README.md) — overview, install, usage, GitHub Action, config
- [llms.txt](llms.txt) — LLM-facing brief (agents read this)
- [LICENSE](LICENSE) — MIT

## Code
- [bin/secflow.js](bin/secflow.js) — the entire CLI (single file, zero deps, Node 18+)
- [action/action.yml](action/action.yml) — composite GitHub Action
- [examples/security.yml](examples/security.yml) — example consumer workflow
- [tests/run.js](tests/run.js) — smoke tests (8 tests, plain node asserts)
- [secflow.yml](secflow.yml) — self-config (excludes tests/ from self-scan)

## CI
- [.github/workflows/security.yml](.github/workflows/security.yml) — self-scan workflow (test suite + gitleaks gate + full scan)

## Config
- [.gitleaks.toml](.gitleaks.toml) — allowlist for test fixtures (regex-based only)
- [.gitignore](.gitignore) — node_modules/, .secflow/, *.log
